Definition: from G4253 and G906; to throw forward, i.e. push to the front, germinate:--put forward, shoot forth.
BiblicalUsage: Proballo means to throw forward, to put forth. Luke uses it for the trees that shoot forth their leaves when summer is near, and Acts for Alexander, thrust forward by the Jews to speak in the uproar at Ephesus.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that putting forth is the sign of the season, and the trees know summer is near before anyone says it.
